college_info.college_name: Hindustan Business School: Courses, Fees, Admission 2025, Reviews, Info

highlights.summary: The Karnataka PGCET 2026 exam for admission to the MBA and MCA courses will be held on May 14, 2026. For the ME/MTech course, the exam is scheduled for May 23, 2026.

placements.overview: Founded in 1994, Hindustan Business School is an institute. It is located in Bangalore, Karnataka. Hindustan Business School provides UG and PG courses in Full Time mode. It provides 6 courses across different specialisations. Some of the courses offered at this institute include MBA/PGDM, B.Sc., BCA, B.Com and BBA. The student intake for these courses is 300. Hindustan Business School offers these course across fields such as Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce and Aviation. Hindustan Business School offers all the campus facilities to students.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Aviation Management - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty, mission of 3 years wasted.

review_content.Placements: My batch contains 45 students. My college didn’t offer any recruiting companies. I took BBA with aviation, and after all the 3 years, the college was providing internship opportunities for only 10 students, and I am one of the ten. The internship was at Blue D-ART Aviation Limited.
review_content.Infrastructure: My classroom contains a projector, good benches, and desks. The library was also there, but the problem was that the campus was too short, and you can’t enjoy campus life. Accommodation is also good, with good money in your pockets. I used to stay in PG, and after a year, my friends and I took a room and contributed money for rent. Food is available for your taste because the street is a food street. Canteen food was friendly with money, but it is cheap.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelors of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: One of the best colleges I have ever seen with good teaching.

review_content.Placements: Top most companies like Accenture, Etihad Airways, SpiceJet, and more come for placements. Top students have more choices; packages are not so bad, but okay. Internships are also offered. The college is located under HAL, in a very good location, with IT parks very near to it. Transportation is good.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good, with a respectful department. Hostels are near the college, and we have a good canteen, as well as medical and sports facilities. The library is also good, and labs are updated. There is no ragging, and it is a strict college with freedom. Well-arranged transportation is available, and the campus is clean and neat.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Aviation Management - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Our college is fine and placements are taking place.

review_content.Placements: Around 20 to 30% of placements are provided. Air India and Indigo are recruiting students. Aviation roles are offered. Mainly aviation companies and other placements are offered. Top roles are placed in airports and airlines.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs, classrooms, and the library are good. Hostel is not running for boys only girls hostel is provided. Canteen facility is available with good food. The availability of sports and games is less. Ground facility is not available.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Aviation Management - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Our college focuses on studies and placements.

review_content.Placements: There are the best placements. Training is provided for freshers.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are less but very much focused on studies and placements. Infrastructure, facilities, extra curriculum activities, and all other general programs are less.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers are helpful. The pass percentage and ranking percentage is very high.
review_content.Other: Due to the pandemic, the last 2 years were less in programs but now all programs are going on and also industrial visits are also set up.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Aviation Management - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Hindustan business school is the best college for aviation. Good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: Placements are still going on some students are placed by themselves and some are from college. The college provides placement but it depends on students. In BBA in aviation course they get job roles in airport or airlines as well as in customer support field.
review_content.Infrastructure: Everything was available such as library, canteen budget friendly food. The hostel of the college is also beside the college and it gives all the facilities including washing machines, breakfast lunch and dinner as well. But the campus is too small for students and it doesn't have a playground where students can have sports activities.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Aviation Management - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: I am not satisfied because the fee structure is high.

review_content.Placements: The eligibility for this course was 50% in 2nd PUC or 2nd higher studies. Almost all airlines were recruited for this course, and top roles were offered at the airport with high salaries. This course is now emerging in India and develops more for future aviators.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities like a library, laboratories, and classrooms were available. The canteen was available, and the food served in the hostel was better at a low price. A playground was not available in this college. Medical facilities were also not provided on campus.

reviews.review_heading: It has really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs were highly developed with every new technology provided. Classrooms were very attractive, which made students focus more. High-quality foods are provided with great extra activities. The timing was also great and very strict so that students could focus more on studies.

reviews.review_heading: College has high placements and college provides add on courses like AI.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities in our college for studying and for other extracurricular activities. We have technical programs, and they are all at their extreme level. Hostels provide security and time limits. All students behave well and have changed their habits nicely.

reviews.review_heading: My class and computer labs are fully Wi-Fi supported, and the college looks nice and beautiful.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure is really good and awesome, just looking like a wow. My class and all computer labs are fully Wi-Fi supported, and the college looks nice and beautiful. My college provides a good and eco-friendly hostel and good canteen facilities.

reviews.review_heading: My college provides scholarships based on caste.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very good. We have all the necessary facilities, like Wi-Fi, a library, classrooms and labs. The classrooms are equipped with teaching materials, and the hotel office is located in our college. The food at the hotel is healthy and medical facilities are available. Our college has many teams in sports and sporting events are organized where we can compete with other colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Review of K.M.M. College of Arts and Science.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. The library has so many books that we can refer to. The psychology lab is efficient. The food available in the canteen is of good quality. We have a field for indoor football matches. The libraries will undoubtedly assist you. The computer lab is also in good condition.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides average facilities, average placements, and good teaching.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are pretty good. Wi-Fi is pretty fast. We have 3 to 6 labs. Classrooms are big and spacious. You can't expect sports and games. The hostels are not good. Most of my classmates stay in private hostels. The ambiance in the college hostel is not good.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and curriculum. Everything is bad apart from them.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are neat and fresh. They have good environment for studies. There are great computer labs too with all the necessities. The library too is very useful and up to date. The college doesn't have its own hostel, which is a great fallback, as many students have to look for private hostels and accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: The best thing is the friends and the worst thing is that there is no place to enjoy with friends.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is not good, it is like a hospital with a lot of rooms and no outside ground. The canteen is the best thing in this college. The snacks and the food is very delicious and fresh and workers are very kind hearted.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college with well-trained teachers.
reviews.review_text: The new block is very good. The new block provides high-speed internet. It has well-maintained classrooms. There is a large football ground near the college. The canteen provides good quality food. The college has a lift facility. There are 2 labs in our college that are computer lab and chemistry lab.

reviews.review_heading: Review of K.M.M. College of Arts and Science.
reviews.review_text: This college has computer IT labs that have all software and a huge number of PCs. Two CCTV cameras are installed in our classroom. Any student can become a member of the library in our college. Our college has a canteen with affordable prices. There is a variety of sports such as football, cricket and others. Moreover, there is a good hostel. Our college has a tiny library, but it publishes six newspapers each day, among which one in English and another one in Malayalam. Classrooms are similar ...

reviews.review_heading: It has decent faculty, nice placements and great infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college has a decently built infrastructure with great lab facilities. The labs do have a good internet connection with Wi-Fi support. The classrooms are spacious, and the libraries have a lot of books available, both academic and non-academic varieties. The college hostel is clean, and the college canteen provides good food at a decent amount. Basic medical facilities are available. Sports events, which include football, cricket, basketball, and athletics are conducted every year.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for all type of students. Easily affordable. Students can enjoy the college life.
reviews.review_text: This college provides computer IT labs with all software installed and many computers. Our classroom contains two cctv camera. Our college has a library in which any one can take membership. Our college has a canteen which has low prices and has selection for all sports like football, cricket, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my college life and the new era.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a free Wi-Fi service and smart classrooms. More than 10,000 books are available in our library. The canteen serves many items and students use the canteen to have lunch. The hostel is very clean and has a vast. Each day, a different type and quality of food is served. It charges a budget-friendly rent.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to enjoy your college days, you have to be a hosteller.
reviews.review_text: The college doesn't have its own hostel, but the college owns some buildings, and there are private hostels in the area. You can first join any hostel you want; after a few days, you can move to any hostel you like in no time. Some awesome seniors can help you.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied of faculty members and good infrastructure in the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructures are good. Need more improvements in sports. Mostly promoting only in cricket and football. Library, canteen and labs all are very good and NEET. And medical room also provided in college. Lift facility also available. And also drinking water available in every floor. Now ending machines also started.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with placements of our college.

content.Placements: TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Capgemini, Wings Group of Solutions, etc., are the top recruiting companies. The other department students also have good placements in the IT field.
content.Infrastructure: In this college, laboratory facilities are good. The canteen is average and sports are also available.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are kind and helpful. Students are well-trained for semester exams and practicals.
content.Other: Fests are conducted every month. Other events like cultural are also held in this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Review of PGP College of Engineering - PGPCE.

content.Placements: We did not get any placements. The college has very poor placement records. They don't provide pre-placement services. Even in the final year of engineering, we did not get any placement services. But, we have attended many aptitude classes. Students participated in many off-campus placement drives.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is huge and accommodates eight colleges. Canteens are not much good. The best thing is we can enjoy on the campus. The campus is spread over 300 acres. We can also practice in many games. Overall according to me, the infrastructure is good. According to me, all labs are poor. They need to develop many labs for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: Good education and good training for lifetime.

content.Placements: I got placed in a good company of Tata Group of business. I am very interested and happy with that placement. I got a good salary with that. Also, a lot of experience with initial stage and how to manage starting days in Chennai was given, and I learnt a lot of things from the beginning stages.
content.Infrastructure: Here, we have a separate building for all departments, and labs are having good facility and good learning. In hostel also, good facilities with separate rooms are available. There is a good environment. The food facility was good in hostel and canteen. There are good places to participate in events and sports. Also, medical facilities are good, and there is a practical experience for nursing students and pharmaceutical students.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges I have seen. Super infrastructure and best-in-class labs.

content.Placements: This college has a good reputation of placing the students in MNCs. The students who have more that 70% marks with no backlogs have been placed. 80% of the students placed have been placed. The salary package varies from 2 lakhs per annum to 5 lakhs per annum. Companies like Tech Mahindra, Infosys, Ameritore, Hexaware, Sutherland, Justdail etc. recruit the students.
content.Infrastructure: This college has a good infrastructure. The classrooms are spacious. Free Wi-Fi is available. There is a good library which has all the recent books. The college has ambulances for students if they need any kind of medical attention and a doctor inside the campus. The labs and classrooms are goods. The quality of food is not bad. The hostel rooms are also good and spacious. I never faced any infrastructure related issues during my tenure at the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2012

content.Other: The college has a good infrastructure and the campus is lovely. But the students are not allowed to utilize it much. The quality of education that they provide is average and the placements are not good. Extra-curricular activities do not happen much.
